allOf.$comment: A Mechanism record must name the class of molecular action it denotes.
The entity must be identified. Three atlases independently chose `id` and `intervention_id`; both are accepted in v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 settles on `id` (docs/ONTOLOGY_NOTES.md deviation D8).
The entity must be named, under one of the three accepted field names.
Authorship must be recorded, in one of the three forms in use.

description: One intervention entity in the intervention layer. Registering an intervention is a cheminformatics or bibliographic act and NEVER an instruction to obtain, administer or self-apply anything. NO DOSE, ROUTE, REGIMEN, INTENSITY OR SCHEDULE MAY BE RECORDED — there is no field for one, and rule V20 rejects the attempt (docs/COMPUTATIONAL_ONLY_POLICY.md). Binding a target is never efficacy: an effect on a state variable needs a separate claim (rule V16).

active_moiety.description: The compound node that carries the activity, when distinct.

acts_on_target.description: The single Target this entity engages.

acts_through.description: Entities this one acts via, when it is not direct.

added_by.description: Agent id that wrote this record.

approval.description: Approval somewhere for some indication. NEVER evidence of cognitive efficacy.

approval_status.description: Approval somewhere for some indication. NEVER evidence of cognitive efficacy.

status.description: As stated by the named source; never inferred.

approved_indication_note.description: What it is approved for elsewhere. NEVER evidence of cognitive efficacy.

attributes.description: Descriptive domain metadata this schema does not model — an AAV construct's serotype, a probe's assay format, a cohort's genotyping array. Values must be STRINGS: a number in an unvalidated bag would escape rule V9's provenance requirement. A HOLDING AREA, not a permanent home — anything here that turns out to be decision-relevant must graduate to a real, validated field through a schema-change request (contract §5.5).

blood_brain_barrier.description: CNS penetration as stated by a source, or `unknown`. NEVER inferred from structure here.

chembl_fields_as_returned.description: Verbatim ChEMBL fields, carried so a database value is never paraphrased. `max_phase` is a development-status field, not an efficacy statement.

chembl_first_approval.description: DEPRECATED SPELLING of first_approval_year; accepted in v0.1.0.

chembl_id.description: ChEMBL accession, seen in a tool response.

chembl_max_phase.description: DEPRECATED SPELLING of max_clinical_phase.value; accepted in v0.1.0. ChEMBL max_phase verbatim: a development-status field, never an efficacy statement.

cited_by_claims.description: Claim ids. Every id must resolve (rule V4).

claim_refs.description: Claim ids. Every id must resolve (rule V4).

conflict_of_interest_note.description: A declared interest visible in the source.

database_source_id.description: The pinned DatabaseRelease these database facts came from. REQUIRED for rule V9 to exempt max_clinical_phase.value and first_approval_year from the no-free-numbers rule: a database fact is admissible because its provenance is visible, not because it is a number somebody trusts.

description.description: What the entity is. Structural, never a protocol.

direction_warning.description: A warning that the direction of effect is unknown, inverted or context-dependent.

dose_information.description: THE ONLY LEGAL VALUE IS `omitted_by_policy`. The field exists so that the absence of dose, route and regimen is an explicit, auditable statement rather than an omission a reader might think accidental. No dose, route, regimen, product or sourcing information is recorded anywhere in this repository (docs/COMPUTATIONAL_ONLY_POLICY.md, rule V20).

dose_response_note.description: What the retrieved text said about the SHAPE of the response. Contains no dose the reader could act on; a stated shape still needs a claim.

efficacy_status.description: What is and is not established about this entity's effect. BINDING IS NEVER EFFICACY (rule V16), so this field usually records the absence of efficacy evidence rather than its presence.

exemplar_interventions.description: Concrete entities illustrating a Mechanism record.

first_approval_year.description: Year of first approval somewhere, as the database states it. A DATABASE FACT, not a judgement: rule V9 exempts it only when `database_source_id` names the pinned release it came from.

human_evidence_summary.description: One paragraph on the human evidence, INCLUDING nulls and failures.

id.description: Intervention node id. THE CANONICAL FIELD.

identifier_provenance.description: How the identifier was obtained, in one line.

identifiers.description: Identifiers seen in a tool response, never typed from memory.

intervention_id.description: Accepted alias of `id`; deprecated in v0.2.0.

known_liabilities.description: An EMPTY list means nobody looked, never 'safe'.

label.description: Plain name, as the source database gives it.

max_clinical_phase.description: Highest clinical phase reached, as a DATABASE FIELD copied verbatim. It describes development status, never efficacy and never cognitive effect. Rule V9 exempts `value` only when the record also names `database_source_id`.

mechanism.description: The single Mechanism node this entity acts through.

mechanism_as_reported.description: The mechanism in the source's own words, verbatim.

mechanism_class.description: Class of molecular action. REQUIRED when node_type is Mechanism.

mechanisms.description: Mechanisms of action as the drug database returned them, one object per mechanism. The structured form is kept rather than flattened to a string because it carries the per-mechanism provenance (`target_chembl_id`, `mechanism_ref_pmid`) that makes the annotation checkable; flattening it would destroy exactly what is worth keeping. Having a mechanism is NOT having an effect (rule V16).

items.description: One mechanism of action, copied from the database with its provenance.

direct_interaction.description: Database flag, verbatim. Not this project's judgement.

disease_efficacy.description: Database flag, verbatim. It refers to the approved indication, NEVER to cognition.

mechanism_id.description: Mechanism node id, when one has been declared.

mechanism_of_action.description: Verbatim mechanism text from the database.

mechanism_ref_pmid.description: PubMed id the database cites for this mechanism.

source_id.description: Registered source for this mechanism, if registered here.

modality.description: The kind of intervention this is; inferable from node_type.

name.description: Accepted alias of `label`; deprecated in v0.2.0.

node_type.description: Which intervention node type this record instantiates.

notes.description: Structural notes only, as one string or a list of them. No dose, route, regimen or protocol.

preferred_name.description: Alternative spelling of `label`. Two atlases chose different names for this field independently; both are accepted in v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 must settle on `label` (see docs/ONTOLOGY_NOTES.md).

provenance.description: Who wrote this record, when and how. The supporting_* lists exist so a database-derived record can name what it aggregates instead of hiding it.

created_by.description: Agent id that wrote this record.

database_release.description: Pinned DatabaseRelease the record was derived from.

pipeline.description: Repo-relative script that produced the record, for database_ingestion. Makes the record rebuildable (P7).

run_id.description: Agent run identifier, for tracing a record to a session.

supporting_accessions.description: Any other accessions the record rests on.

supporting_pubmed_ids.description: PubMed ids the database record itself cites.

supporting_study_ids.description: Study accessions the database record aggregates.

supporting_study_locus_ids.description: Opaque per-locus keys from the source database.

recorded_by.description: Agent id that wrote this record.

related_probes_named_in_retrieved_text.description: Other probes the retrieved text named. Not endorsements.

role_in_atlas.description: Why this atlas registered the entity at all.

schema_version.description: Contract version this record was written against.

scope_limits.description: What this entity does NOT show. Honest scoping.

state_variables_touched.description: State variables the CITED CLAIMS bear on. Registration only: it asserts no direction and no effect (rule V16).

supports_effect_claims.description: Claim ids. Every id must resolve (rule V4).

synonyms_as_reported.description: Synonyms exactly as the database returned them.

targets.description: Engagement only. NOT an efficacy assertion (rule V16).

vector_serotype.description: Delivery vector as named by the source, for GeneRegulation.

title: Intervention entity
